title: Durable known-subject CACHE cleanup
scope: Extend the existing bounded erasure job to discover, durably checkpoint and delete known tenant-scoped subject profile and override CACHE keys without reinterpreting pending version-1 cursors.
non_goals: Partial W06/F06/N05 known-subject CACHE repair only. No email/account alias inference, unscoped/full-cache scan, shared config/datafile deletion, in-memory isolate purge, orphan discovery, stale-cookie/session/capability generation, concurrent writer fence, ring/seen/D1/AE/log/external erasure, approved retention or accountability policy.
Preserve point-in-time erasure semantics and explicit incomplete receipt. Do not invent D03 transactional authority, D06 retention/re-entry policy, deployed cleanup or exhaustive deletion.

One production module and one existing fixture only. No new harness/suite, broad build, request-time scorer/SDK change, deployment, cloud, credentials, customer data, commit/push, destructive cleanup or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Before destructive work, a new versioned erasure job freezes only immutable discovered targets' tenant-scoped profile:<id>, profile:user:<id>, profile:anon:<id> keys and every key from complete strict pagination of override:<id>:. Missing CACHE, list failure, malformed/repeated cursor or unsafe key fails without deletion; no email/shared/foreign-tenant key is inferred.

Each frozen CACHE deletion is part of the existing bounded checkpointed job and is idempotently resumable after delete/checkpoint ambiguity without losing targets or reporting completion early. Pending version-1 numeric cursors retain their exact legacy step meaning and can finish after discovery links disappear; compact v1 completion is not retroactively promoted.

The existing identity fixture proves actual known profile/override removal and cold/absent reads, complete pagination, non-target and two-non-default-tenant preservation, discovery/delete/checkpoint/binding failure truth, nonzero v1 continuation, 32-step continuation and both-host compatibility. Worker exact K1 plus app noEmit/scoped diff; independent exact K1 once and frozen source/proof/import pins.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest; actual identity route/job, tenant CACHE wrapper, reset and ledger helpers with the existing synthetic KV/R2/DO seams. No external network.
checks.workload: One existing identity suite only; grouped cache-key discovery/deletion/retry/version compatibility plus existing both-host and bounded-job cases. Worker app noEmit and scoped diff; no engine latency claim.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.04 actual source and complete worker proof review; exact K1 once; relevant local import graph and physical pins; retain review-v1.md.
checks.runtime: Independent local frozen artifact review; actual route/job with synthetic storage only.
checks.workload: C1-C3 known CACHE keys, pagination, deletion/checkpoint recovery, tenant/target isolation and v1 cursor compatibility; inspect compiler/scoped diff evidence without rerun. No broad/deployed qualification.

dependencies.consumed_output: Existing durable discovered-target job, per-step checkpoints, bounded continuation, both-host cleanup and honest incomplete receipt.
dependencies.rationale: CACHE deletion extends that exact job while preserving pending version-1 execution semantics.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future serialized authority for concurrent cross-store erasure and ingestion.
dependencies.rationale: Checkpointed exact CACHE deletion does not fence a concurrent profile writer.

dependencies.rationale: This task deletes current known keys without choosing future re-entry semantics.

handoff.next_action: Implement version-compatible known-subject CACHE deletion in the existing erasure job and identity fixture; freeze for independent review.
